wiki.title: Joe Sosnowski
wiki.extract: Joe Sosnowski (born April 13, 1977) is a member of the Illinois House of Representatives, first elected to represent the 69th district in 2010. The district includes all or portions of the municipalities of Rockford, Belvidere, Capron, Cherry Valley, Lakewood, Loves Park, Garden Prairie, Marengo, Union, Harvard, Hebron, Huntley, Poplar Grove, Richmond, Wonder Lake, and Woodstock.
